description: This file declares the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which inherits from WPEFramework::Core::JSONRPC::Message. It provides methods to access response ID, check if the response is a result or error, retrieve result or error JSON objects, and validate the response. The class is part of a WebSockets JSON-RPC implementation.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message in the WebSockets namespace, providing accessors for response ID, result, error, and validity checks.

methods.name: ~Response
methods.description: Default destructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the response.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result JSON object from the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response contains an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error JSON object from the response.
